description: Bulk update multiple Zendesk organizations in a single request. Use when you need to update organization details such as name, notes, details, domain names, or tags for multiple organizations at once. The action is queued as a background job - use the job_status URL to poll for completion. Maximum 100 organizations per request. Note: Agents without permission restrictions can only update 'notes' on organizations.

inputSchema.description: Request to update multiple organizations in Zendesk.

external_ids.description: Comma-separated list of external organization IDs to update (max 100). Required if ids is not provided.
external_ids.human_parameter_description: A comma-separated list of external organization IDs to update. Maximum 100 IDs allowed. Required if ids is not provided.
external_ids.title: External Ids

ids.description: Comma-separated list of organization IDs to update (max 100). Required if external_ids is not provided.
ids.human_parameter_description: A comma-separated list of Zendesk organization IDs to update (e.g., 1,2,3). Maximum 100 IDs allowed. Required if external_ids is not provided.
ids.title: Ids

organizations.description: List of organizations to update. Each organization must include an 'id' and can optionally include 'name', 'notes', 'details', 'external_id', 'domain_names', and 'tags'. Agents without permission restrictions can only update 'notes'.
organizations.human_parameter_description: An array of organization update objects. Each object requires an 'id' field and can optionally include 'name', 'notes', 'details', 'external_id', 'domain_names', and 'tags'.

items.description: Individual organization update item for bulk update.

details.human_parameter_description: Update the details field for the organization.
details.title: Details

domain_names.description: Updated domain names for the organization (full replacement)
domain_names.human_parameter_description: Set the domain names for the organization. This is a full replacement, so include existing domains along with new ones to avoid removing them.
domain_names.title: Domain Names

external_id.description: Updated external ID for the organization
external_id.human_parameter_description: Set or update the external ID for the organization.
external_id.title: External Id

id.description: The ID of the organization to update
id.human_parameter_description: The unique numeric ID of the Zendesk organization you want to update. You can find organization IDs from the List Organizations action.
id.title: Id

name.human_parameter_description: Set a new name for the organization.
name.title: Name

notes.description: Updated internal notes for the organization
notes.human_parameter_description: Update the internal notes field for the organization.
notes.title: Notes

tags.human_parameter_description: Update the tags for the organization.
tags.title: Tags
